{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify: should now have 800 unique patients
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')

# Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].copy()
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL across ALL patients (800)
mean_biomarker_final_ngml = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final_ngml}')"}
